Jordan (data-platform): Heads-up — proposal to evolve the analytics.events shape to an 'envelope' JSONB so we can version payload types without adding dozens of nullable columns.
Sam (eng-platform): curious — what's the minimal change? full rewrite or additive?
Jordan (data-platform): additive. plan: add envelope JSONB, keep existing columns for 90 days, dual-write from API during rollout, backfill historical rows async. read path will prefer envelope when present.
Olivia (console): any impact on dashboards/metrics joins? we join events -> routes for per-route dashboards, will that change indexes?
Jordan (data-platform): index strategy: keep existing PK and event_time index. create GIN index on envelope->'type' and envelope->'route_id' for queryable fields. don't remove old columns until after deprecation window.
Lee (eng-ml): for model telemetry we need stable keys. can we normalize envelope.type values? maybe a small enum mapping at ingest so ML pipelines don't break.
Jordan (data-platform): good call — add an ingest normalization step that maps legacy event_type -> canonical_type. we'll emit migration_version tag to telemetry.
Sam (eng-platform): rollout plan sketch:
1) Add column + GIN index (no blocking)
2) Deploy API dual-write behind feature flag (2% canary -> 25% -> 100%)
3) Run backfill job to populate envelope for historical rows (rate-limited)
4) Migrate consumers to read from envelope with fallback to old fields
5) Drop old columns after verification and retention window

Sam (eng-platform): can we avoid a long exclusive lock on the big table when adding column/index? use CONCURRENTLY for index and add column with default NULL so no table rewrite.
Jordan (data-platform): yep — ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN envelope JSONB; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON analytics.events USING gin (envelope jsonb_path_ops); will be in runbook. backfill as batch UPDATEs with small txn sizes.
Olivia (console): Console needs to show a migration banner and have a toggle to switch queries for older customers. UX: expose a 'compatibility mode' per org while we migrate.
Lee (eng-ml): also add a telemetry event when a consumer falls back to legacy fields so we can measure adoption (%) by org.\nJordan (data-platform): suggested SQL for backfill job:
```sql
-- backfill 1k rows at a time
BEGIN;
UPDATE analytics.events
SET envelope = jsonb_build_object('type', event_type, 'payload', payload, 'ingest_v', 'v2')
WHERE envelope IS NULL
LIMIT 1000;
COMMIT;
```

Jordan (data-platform): we'll run on a worker fleet with concurrency throttle; monitor replication lag.
Sam (eng-platform): compatibility concerns: some downstream ETL jobs expect flat columns. we'll add a shim in the pipeline that expands envelope -> columns until we flip. also announce schema_version header for internal API.
Olivia (console): two requests: 1) add migration_version and schema_version tags to all emitted events; 2) update dashboard docs and saved queries list so users don't get broken queries.
Jordan (data-platform): agreed. we'll add a migration changelog in console release notes and a per-org migration progress page.
Lee (eng-ml): how do we handle retention/quotas? envelope might increase row size. need to check cost/egress for export pipelines.
Sam (eng-platform): plan to compress envelope with JSONB and rely on GIN selective indexing. also check S3 export size delta on sample.
Jordan (data-platform): rollback plan: stop writes to envelope (feature flag off), ensure consumers read old columns, re-run backfill later. also keep a short-term tombstone flag for rows migrated in case we need to revert.

migrations-bot: migration/1790011222/backfill-job started by jordan — job-id=mf-8932 :eyes:
Sam (eng-platform): :thumbsup: can we add a pre-migration smoke test that runs sample queries against a staging replica?
Jordan (data-platform): yes — smoke test list: per-route aggregation, count by type, time-windowed sessionization. will add to runbook.
Olivia (console): I'll draft the console banner and the saved query audit this afternoon. tagging @Sam for API header change.
Sam (eng-platform): I'll open the canary flag and add metrics for fallback-rate, backfill-progress, and index build time.
Lee (eng-ml): I'll add a gating eval to ensure model features computed from events are stable before we drop columns.
Jordan (data-platform): thanks — putting an action list in runbook now. we should be able to start the canary next week after index build and a dry-run backfill in staging.
Sam (eng-platform): ok moving to #incidents if we see replication issues. otherwise will update thread with canary numbers.
Olivia (console): noted — will coordinate docs + banner.
migrations-bot: migration/1790011222/backfill-job completed: processed=145000 duration=2h12m errors=0 :tada:
Sam (eng-platform): awesome, progress! next: enable 2% canary flag tomorrow morning.
